zh: 为回答问题，本策略将本次输入及同一 Session 内最多七组较早的输入和回答（历史最多 64 KiB，共最多八轮）发送至 {{recipient}}，由 {{provider}} 通过 {{endpointDisclosure}} 处理。来源区域为 {{sourceRegion}}，处理区域为 {{processingRegion}}，存储区域为 {{storageRegion}}。供应商保留信息：{{providerRetentionDisclosure}}。服务器输入和回答遵循 retain_after_hide_v1：删除会话或账号会隐藏正文，隐藏不等于已永久删除；导出及敏感资料删除沿原有数据管理机制处理。可撤回后续处理许可；撤回、到期或来源隐藏后不继续使用历史。普通追问和明确纠正在原服务任务内继续，每次模型尝试仍受实际预算和容量限制。新 Session 不读取其他 Session；不会自动修改 Trip 或长期 Memory。
en: To answer, this policy sends the current input and up to seven earlier input/answer pairs from this same Session (at most 64 KiB of serialized history and eight total turns) to {{recipient}}, processed by {{provider}} through {{endpointDisclosure}}. Source region: {{sourceRegion}}; processing region: {{processingRegion}}; storage region: {{storageRegion}}. Provider retention disclosure: {{providerRetentionDisclosure}}. Server input and answers use retain_after_hide_v1: deleting a conversation or account hides content; hiding does not mean permanent erasure. Export and sensitive-data deletion use the original data-management mechanism. You can withdraw further processing permission; withdrawal, expiry or hidden sources prevent further use of history. Follow-ups and explicit corrections continue the original ServiceTask, and each model attempt remains subject to actual budget and capacity limits. A new Session does not read another Session. Trip and long-term Memory are not changed automatically.
